FAQ.ai_point_a: Each AI model call uses Credits. The system bills based on the actual usage reported by the model provider.
FAQ.ai_point_expire_a: No. Your Credits stay in your account and are not cleared when a plan expires.
FAQ.browser_billing_a: Like a normal chat, it is billed by actual usage, not by the minute. Idle time is free and each run has a cap; failed or stopped runs only bill for the usage already incurred. The desktop app uses your local browser and incurs no cloud browser fee.
FAQ.browser_billing_q: How is the errand browser billed?
FAQ.check_subscription_a: Go to Account → Personal and click Plan details to view your current plan, remaining Credits and expiration date; purchase records are available under My Orders.
FAQ.check_subscription_q: Where can I view my subscription plans?
FAQ.dataset_compute_a: One Dataset storage unit equals one Dataset index. A single chunk usually creates multiple indexes, displayed as "n index groups" in its Dataset collection.
FAQ.index_del_a: When you delete Dataset content, its index count decreases within five minutes.
FAQ.index_del_q: When does the Dataset index count decrease?
FAQ.package_overlay_a: Yes. Add-ons stack while they are active, and Credits from Credits packs are added straight to your Credits balance.
FAQ.qpm_a: QPM is the maximum number of Agent requests your team can make per minute, regardless of an individual Agent's complexity. Other OpenAPI endpoints are also rate-limited separately.
FAQ.switch_package_a: Purchased plans take effect immediately; any remaining time on your current plan is extended automatically.
FAQ.switch_package_q: When does a newly purchased subscription Plan take effect?
FAQ.upload_limit_a: Up to 8 files per upload, each no larger than 20MB. PDF, Word, Excel and common text formats are supported.
FAQ.upload_limit_q: Are there any limits on file uploads?
FAQ.year_day_a: A month is calculated as 30 days, and a year as 360 days.
FAQ.year_day_q: How many days are in a billing month or year?
